name: Golden Syrup
siboNotes: Contains excess free fructose which can feed bacterial overgrowth. Use sparingly even within low FODMAP limits during SIBO treatment.
preparationTips: Measure carefully as serving sizes are very small
Can be diluted with water for lighter sweetening
Warm slightly for easier measuring and mixing
Store in cool, dry place to prevent crystallization
nutritionalHighlights: Provides quick energy from simple carbohydrates
Contains trace minerals from sugar processing
High in calories - about 60 calories per tablespoon
